summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting (investigation only, no changes made)  **What I found before writing this plan:** I read the full chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, and the session/cookie code in `db/auth.ts` / `modules/auth/handlers.ts`. Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, everything I read is already correctly wired: - Every watchlist route requires a valid session cookie and injects `X-User-Id` from it (no anonymous/guest fallback exists). - Every read/write handler filters or write
